name: What is a pocket door and how does it work?

mainEntity.name: What is a pocket door and how does it work?

acceptedAnswer.text: A pocket door is a sliding door that disappears, or 'pockets,' into a compartment in the adjacent wall when fully open. This design frees up floor space that a traditional hinged door would require for its swing radius. It operates on a track system installed within the wall cavity, allowing the door panel to glide smoothly in and out of the wall.
acceptedAnswer.description: A pocket door slides into a wall compartment, saving space compared to traditional hinged doors.
